Link_Rationale: Sampling density and mapped elements refine the surface-composition context already represented by E047.
Copper-chloride accumulation supports a corrosion/alteration layer relevant to H20 but does not by itself prove all depositional phases.
Zinc-rich residues attributed to brass brushes support a restoration-phase contribution to the surface history.
The same zinc evidence limits direct depositional interpretation of Bronze B surface chemistry because some signal derives from modern cleaning.
PCA/HCA discrimination of most A and B patinas supports differentiated surface histories but only indirectly bears on H20.
